intro: Tanis Alderwood thanks you for helping him and calls you a friend. Danitha Morr recognizes the small act as a way to strengthen the Forsaken's connection to the Light.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well, friend. It was a small thing, but even small acts of service such as this may help strengthen our connection to the light.

The Dark Lady and many in her service mistrust us. Some even conspire against us, but we will visit their skepticism and fear with courage and righteousness. We will show them that we are members of the Forsaken and we are willing to do our part, be it large or small, to help our people prosper once again.
Take this symbol, you will need it for what comes next.
